entries: **World Cup panel: each team's squad size now reflects its usage**: a side using more of its session quota fields more players (5–8) and presses its formation toward midfield, sharing the same session-percent signal that already drives the ball drift.

**Models with no pricing data show "—" instead of a misleading $0.00**: the cost column rendered unknown models as $0.00, which reads as free rather than unknown; unavailable costs now render as "—" in both the HTML report and the CSV export.

**Codex quota rows are labelled by window length**: the free-plan 30-day window no longer shows as "Session" — each row's label now comes from the window length Codex reports (≈ Session / Weekly / Monthly).

**World Cup quota bars now fill their whole half**: the duel bars used auto-margins that bunched both fills against the centre line, leaving the outer ends blank so a 100% side never reached the track edge; each fill is now anchored to the centre and extended outward.

**Faster Codex log parsing**: unchanged session files are no longer re-read on every poll, and a versioned on-disk cache lets a fresh launch reuse prior parse results instead of re-scanning all history cold.

title.zh-TW: 世界盃面板更好看，查不到價格的模型不再假裝免費
title.en: The World Cup panel looks better, and models with no price stop pretending to be free

body.zh-TW: 許多小地方的顯示變精確了。在「世界盃」面板裡，現在哪邊用量高，哪邊場上的球員就會比較多，而且會壓著對方打；原本兩邊的進度條擠在中間填不滿，現在也能正常從中間往兩邊完整填滿。另外，當系統查不到某個 AI 模型的定價時，以前會顯示誤導人的「$0.00」（看起來像免費），現在會誠實地顯示「—」。而且，Codex 的額度列現在會乖乖照著 Session、每週、每月這種真實時間窗來標示，不再把 30 天的額度誤標成 Session 了。最後，Codex 解析速度變快了，冷啟動時不用再把舊紀錄全部重看一遍。就像你查某件商品的價格，以前查不到系統就直接標 0 元讓你白高興一場，現在會老實畫一條線告訴你它不知道。
body.en: Several visual details have been sharpened up. In the "World Cup" panel, the side burning more usage will now field more players on the pitch and push their formation forward aggressively; also, the two duel bars that used to get stuck near the middle now properly fill all the way to the edges. Separately, when the system can't find pricing data for an AI model, it used to show a misleading "$0.00" (making it look free), but now it honestly displays a "—". Furthermore, Codex quota rows are now accurately labelled according to their true time window (Session, Weekly, Monthly), so a 30-day quota is no longer mistakenly labelled as a Session. Finally, parsing Codex logs is much faster now, so a fresh launch no longer has to sluggishly re-read your entire history. It's like checking the price tag on an item: the scanner used to ring up $0 and give you false hope when it couldn't find the barcode, but now it simply draws a dash to admit it doesn't know.

entries: **A panel that fails to load is no longer pinned to its error screen until restart**: the panel caching added in 0.22.7 stored whatever `build_view` returned — including the `ErrorPanelView` fallback shown when a panel's HTML can't be read — so once a load failed, switching back kept showing the error even after the file was available again. usage now caches only successfully-built web views; a failed build is shown but left uncached and rebuilt on the next switch, so a transient read failure recovers on its own.

title.zh-TW: 面板萬一載入失敗，不會再永遠卡在錯誤畫面
title.en: Panels no longer get permanently stuck on the error screen if they fail to load

body.zh-TW: 你現在切換面板萬一遇到載入失敗，不會再永遠卡在錯誤畫面了。0.22.7 版雖然讓面板切換變快，但如果某個面板剛好讀取失敗顯示了錯誤畫面，它就會把那個錯誤畫面「快取」起來，導致你之後怎麼切換都只看得到那個錯誤，除非整個程式重開。現在系統學乖了，只有成功載入的面板才會被存起來；如果失敗了，它下次會再努力重讀一次。就像一台會記住畫面的電視機，以前連藍畫面死機都記下來天天播給你聽，現在它只記住正常的節目，碰到雜訊下次懂得自己重抓訊號。
body.en: If you switch panels and encounter a loading failure, you will no longer get permanently stuck on the error screen. While version 0.22.7 made switching panels faster, it had a flaw: if a panel failed to load and showed an error screen, it would "cache" that error screen, meaning you'd be stuck looking at that error every time you switched back until you restarted the app. The system has learned its lesson and now only caches successfully loaded panels; if it fails, it will simply try to reload it fresh next time. It's like a TV that records the last channel you watched — it used to record the blue screen of death and replay it for you endlessly, but now it only records actual broadcasts and knows to re-tune the antenna if it hits static.

items.original: **A panel that fails to load is no longer pinned to its error screen until restart**: the panel caching added in 0.22.7 stored whatever `build_view` returned — including the `ErrorPanelView` fallback shown when a panel's HTML can't be read — so once a load failed, switching back kept showing the error even after the file was available again. usage now caches only successfully-built web views; a failed build is shown but left uncached and rebuilt on the next switch, so a transient read failure recovers on its own.

entries: **Switching panels no longer flickers**: every switch tore down the WKWebView and reloaded its HTML, exposing the dark backing layer until the load finished — a visible flicker, plus the popover closed and reopened. usage now caches each panel's web view (lazily, capped at 6 with LRU eviction) inside a container view and switches by toggling visibility and re-injecting the latest state, so a previously-opened panel reappears instantly with no reload. The first build of a panel fades in from a same-color overlay that is removed on the first successful paint (or after a 1.5s safety timeout). The popover no longer closes and reopens on switch.

title.zh-TW: 切換不同主題面板時不再閃爍，而且瞬間出現
title.en: Switching theme panels is now instant and flicker-free

body.zh-TW: 在切換不同的面板主題時，畫面變得非常滑順。以前每次換面板，系統都會把整個視窗關掉重開、而且會先露出底下的深色背景閃一下；現在系統會把你開過的面板（最多記 6 個）悄悄藏在背後，切換時只負責把最新的數字填進去再端出來。所以只要是開過的面板，切換過去就是瞬間出現，沒有任何閃爍，連視窗都不用關閉重開。就像換佈景，以前是把整個舞台布幕拉下來拆掉重裝，現在是舞台底下早就準備好多個旋轉舞台，轉過來就能直接演。
body.en: Switching between different theme panels is now incredibly smooth. Previously, every time you switched panels, the system would tear down and reopen the entire window, exposing the dark background for a split-second flicker. Now, the system quietly keeps the panels you've opened (up to 6) waiting in the background. When you switch, it simply injects the latest numbers and brings the panel to the front. This means any previously opened panel reappears instantly with zero flickering, and the window itself never closes and reopens. It's like changing theatre sets: instead of dropping the curtain and tearing down the whole stage, they now have multiple rotating stages fully prepared underneath, seamlessly spinning into place ready for the next act.

items.original: **Switching panels no longer flickers**: every switch tore down the WKWebView and reloaded its HTML, exposing the dark backing layer until the load finished — a visible flicker, plus the popover closed and reopened. usage now caches each panel's web view (lazily, capped at 6 with LRU eviction) inside a container view and switches by toggling visibility and re-injecting the latest state, so a previously-opened panel reappears instantly with no reload. The first build of a panel fades in from a same-color overlay that is removed on the first successful paint (or after a 1.5s safety timeout). The popover no longer closes and reopens on switch.

entries: **Annual Wrapped and the 52-week contribution heatmap no longer lose history when source logs are pruned**: the year view recomputed everything from whatever Claude Code / Codex session logs still existed on disk, so once those logs were rotated away it could only ever show the last ~2 months. usage now persists a daily ledger (`~/.usage/year_ledger.json`) that accumulates over time — each rebuild merges the currently-available days in (overwriting a stored day only when the fresh total is at least as large, so a partially-pruned day can't shrink the record) and trims entries beyond the 53-week window. The heatmap, streaks, active days, and Wrapped totals are all computed from the merged ledger, so coverage fills toward a full year from here on.

title.zh-TW: 你的年度回顧與熱力圖不會因為對話紀錄被清掉而跟著縮水
title.en: Your year-in-review and heatmap no longer shrink when chat logs are cleared

body.zh-TW: 年度回顧的各種總計與 52 週熱力圖，現在會自己記帳，不會再因為舊對話紀錄被砍掉而失憶了。以前它們每次都是從你電腦上現存的對話紀錄重算一次，所以只要紀錄被清掉，你的回顧就只剩下最近兩個月；現在系統每天會自己把當天的成績抄進一本專用的「帳本」裡保存下來。就算你把舊對話全砍了，帳本上的紀錄還是會保留著（最多保留 53 週，超過這個窗口的舊資料會被自動修剪掉）。就像以前老師算學期總成績是去數你抽屜裡還剩幾張考卷，現在老師會每天把分數登記在成績單上，就算考卷弄丟了分數也不會不見。
body.en: Your Year in Review totals and the 52-week heatmap now keep their own ledger and won't suffer from amnesia just because your old chat logs get cleaned up. Previously, they recalculated everything from scratch using whatever conversation logs still existed on your computer, meaning if your logs got rotated out, your review shrank to just the last two months. Now, the system copies your daily score into a dedicated "ledger" every single day. Even if you completely delete all your old chats, the records in the ledger remain untouched (up to a 53-week window, beyond which older data is automatically trimmed). It's like a teacher who used to calculate your final grade by counting how many tests you still kept in your desk — now they record your score in a gradebook every day, so even if you lose the actual test papers, your points are safe.

items.original: **Annual Wrapped and the 52-week contribution heatmap no longer lose history when source logs are pruned**: the year view recomputed everything from whatever Claude Code / Codex session logs still existed on disk, so once those logs were rotated away it could only ever show the last ~2 months. usage now persists a daily ledger (`~/.usage/year_ledger.json`) that accumulates over time — each rebuild merges the currently-available days in (overwriting a stored day only when the fresh total is at least as large, so a partially-pruned day can't shrink the record) and trims entries beyond the 53-week window. The heatmap, streaks, active days, and Wrapped totals are all computed from the merged ledger, so coverage fills toward a full year from here on.

entries: **Panel no longer goes permanently blank after a context-menu "Reload"**: the popover panel loads its HTML via `loadHTMLString` with no base URL, so the WKWebView system context-menu Reload reloaded `about:blank` and left the panel blank with no obvious way to recover (#42). usage now strips navigation items (Reload/back/forward/open/download) from the panel's context menu, and internal reloads re-inject the original HTML instead of calling `reload()` — which also fixes panel recovery after the web-content process is terminated.

title.zh-TW: 不小心按到右鍵「重新載入」不會再讓面板變成一片死白
title.en: Accidental right-click "Reload" no longer breaks the panel into a permanent blank screen

body.zh-TW: 以前在面板上按滑鼠右鍵選「重新載入（Reload）」，面板會永遠變成一片空白，除非整個程式重開不然救不回來。現在系統直接把右鍵選單裡那些沒用的網頁導航按鈕（重新載入、上一頁、下一頁）拿掉了，而且內部的重載機制也改成重新把畫面畫出來，不會再傻傻地載入空白網頁。這也順便修好了一個問題：當系統在背後把網頁畫面偷偷關掉時，現在它懂得自己重新畫回來。就像以前你不小心按到電視遙控器的重設鍵，畫面就全黑再也打不開，現在它把那顆危險的按鈕藏起來了。
body.en: If you accidentally right-clicked the panel and selected "Reload", the panel used to turn permanently blank, leaving no way to recover short of restarting the entire app. The system has now stripped those useless web-navigation buttons (Reload, Back, Forward) from the context menu entirely, and the internal reloading mechanism now redraws the actual screen instead of foolishly loading a blank page. This also fixed a related issue: if the system silently killed the web view in the background, it now knows how to redraw itself automatically. It's like accidentally hitting the factory-reset button on your TV remote and having the screen go black forever — the system now hides that dangerous button away.

items.original: **Panel no longer goes permanently blank after a context-menu "Reload"**: the popover panel loads its HTML via `loadHTMLString` with no base URL, so the WKWebView system context-menu Reload reloaded `about:blank` and left the panel blank with no obvious way to recover (#42). usage now strips navigation items (Reload/back/forward/open/download) from the panel's context menu, and internal reloads re-inject the original HTML instead of calling `reload()` — which also fixes panel recovery after the web-content process is terminated.

entries: **Analysis report no longer crashes with "bad local file header" inside the packaged .app**: the report modules (`analyzer`/`adapters`/`ui`) were compiled into the bundle's `python313.zip` and loaded lazily via `zipimport`, so a single corrupt zip entry surfaced as a `ZipImportError` the moment a report was generated. They are now unzipped into the bundle as real directories (py2app `packages`), bypassing `zipimport` entirely. The bundle's `python313.zip` also no longer ships CPython's test suite, pytest, or setuptools, shrinking it from 1665 to 819 entries and cutting the surface for a corrupt entry. This deepens the packaged-report fix from 0.22.2.

title.zh-TW: 產出分析報告不再因為壓縮包裡一個壞檔就全盤崩潰
title.en: Generating analysis reports no longer completely crashes due to one corrupt zip entry

body.zh-TW: 在打包好的獨立 App 裡點擊產出分析報告時，不會再因為遇到一個 `bad local file header` 錯誤就整個崩潰了。以前報告相關的程式碼是被硬塞在一個壓縮包（zip）裡，要用的時候才解壓縮，所以只要裡面有任何一個檔案壞掉，產生報告的瞬間就會整組壞光光。現在系統直接把它們解開成真實的資料夾來讀取，完全避開了這個風險；同時也順手把壓縮包裡不必要的測試程式清掉，讓出錯的機率變得更低。就像以前你把所有工具都塞在一個打不開的生鏽鐵箱裡，現在直接把它們排在架子上，要用哪個拿哪個，再也不會因為鐵箱卡住而沒戲唱了。
body.en: When clicking to generate an analysis report in the packaged standalone App, it will no longer completely crash due to a `bad local file header` error. Previously, the report-related code was jammed into a zip archive and unpacked lazily, meaning if a single file inside was corrupted, the entire report generation would blow up instantly. Now, the system extracts them into real directories for reading, completely bypassing this risk; at the same time, unnecessary testing programs were stripped from the archive, further lowering the chances of anything going wrong. It's like you used to shove all your tools into a rusty toolbox that wouldn't open — now you just organize them cleanly on a shelf, grab what you need, and never have your work halted by a stuck latch.

items.original: **Analysis report no longer crashes with "bad local file header" inside the packaged .app**: the report modules (`analyzer`/`adapters`/`ui`) were compiled into the bundle's `python313.zip` and loaded lazily via `zipimport`, so a single corrupt zip entry surfaced as a `ZipImportError` the moment a report was generated. They are now unzipped into the bundle as real directories (py2app `packages`), bypassing `zipimport` entirely. The bundle's `python313.zip` also no longer ships CPython's test suite, pytest, or setuptools, shrinking it from 1665 to 819 entries and cutting the surface for a corrupt entry. This deepens the packaged-report fix from 0.22.2.

entries: **Warns when the status line stops updating while you're still working**: the menu bar percentage comes only from the file the status line hook writes, so if that hook gets unwired (another tool rewrites `settings.json`) or stops firing, the pinned number would silently freeze. usage now detects this — when the status file hasn't updated for 30 minutes but your `~/.claude/projects` logs show recent activity — and shows an actionable warning telling you to re-run `--setup` or restart Claude Code. The last known percentage is kept, never fabricated, and there is still no network call.

title.zh-TW: 選單列數字卡住不更新時，現在會主動跳出警告教你修
title.en: The app now warns you and helps you fix a frozen menu bar percentage

body.zh-TW: 選單列上釘著的用量百分比，如果因為背後的工具設定跑掉而卡住不更新，現在系統不會再讓你傻傻看著死掉的數字了。當它發現你明明還在聊天（專案紀錄有在動），但狀態檔卻超過 30 分鐘沒更新時，就會主動跳出警告，並教你重新跑一次 `--setup` 或重開程式來修復。它會保留最後一次抓到的真實數字，絕對不會自己亂掰，而且一樣完全不連網。就像你看著時鐘以為還早，現在時鐘沒電不走了，它會自己彈出一個牌子提醒你「我沒電了，快換電池」，而不是讓你錯過開會時間。
body.en: If the pinned usage percentage on your menu bar gets stuck because the underlying tool's settings got disconnected, the system will no longer let you stare blindly at a dead number. If it detects that you're clearly still chatting (your project logs show activity) but the status file hasn't updated in over 30 minutes, it will proactively pop up an actionable warning teaching you to re-run `--setup` or restart the app to fix it. It preserves the last known real number, never fabricates data, and remains completely offline. It's like looking at a clock thinking you have plenty of time: instead of quietly dying on the wall and making you miss a meeting, the clock now pops up a sign saying "I'm out of battery, change it now."

The last known percentage is kept, never fabricated, and there is still no network call.

entries: **HTML report no longer fails inside the packaged .app**: the year-in-review spirit images (phoenix/dragon) were resolved with a source-tree path that doesn't exist in the py2app bundle, so generating any report raised `FileNotFoundError`. They are now resolved through the bundle's resource path, with the source-tree path kept as a fallback for source/CLI runs.

title.zh-TW: 獨立 App 產出報告時不再因為找不到神獸圖片而崩潰
title.en: Packaged app stops crashing over missing spirit images when generating reports

body.zh-TW: 如果你是直接執行打包好的獨立 App（.app），現在產出年度報告時不會再直接當掉了。以前在算年度回顧時，系統會去抓鳳凰或飛龍的圖片，但它找圖片的路徑是用給開發者看的原始碼路徑，所以在打包好的 App 裡根本找不到，導致整個報告出不來。現在它懂得在打包好的資源資料夾裡找圖片了，讓報告能順利生出來。就像你把食譜帶去別人家廚房煮菜，以前一直去原本家裡的位置找鹽巴所以煮不出來，現在懂得在別人家的調味料櫃裡找了。
body.en: If you're running the standalone packaged App (.app), generating the annual report will no longer cause it to crash outright. Previously, when calculating the year-in-review, the system tried to fetch the phoenix or dragon images using a source code path meant for developers. This path didn't exist inside the packaged app, causing the entire report generation to fail. Now, it knows to look for the images inside the bundled resources folder, ensuring the report generates smoothly. It's like taking a recipe to cook in someone else's kitchen: you used to fail because you kept reaching for salt in the exact spot it is in your own house, but now you know to look in the host's actual spice cabinet.

items.original: **HTML report no longer fails inside the packaged .app**: the year-in-review spirit images (phoenix/dragon) were resolved with a source-tree path that doesn't exist in the py2app bundle, so generating any report raised `FileNotFoundError`. They are now resolved through the bundle's resource path, with the source-tree path kept as a fallback for source/CLI runs.

entries: **Idle menu-bar refreshes no longer react to unrelated agent state writes**: FSEvents now watches Claude and Codex usage-history directories instead of their entire data roots, and unchanged status titles no longer trigger redundant AppKit layout work.

title.zh-TW: 選單列不再因為無關的檔案變動而白忙一場
title.en: Menu bar stops useless refreshes on unrelated file changes

body.zh-TW: 你的選單列現在不會再因為無關的檔案變動而莫名其妙重新排版了。以前系統在背後監聽時會盯著整個資料夾看，只要有任何代理（agent）寫入無關的狀態檔，選單列就會傻傻地跟著刷新；現在它只會緊盯 Claude 與 Codex 真正用來記錄歷史的特定資料夾，而且如果標題根本沒變，它就不會浪費力氣重新排版。就像警衛以前只要看到大樓裡有人走動就全棟廣播，現在只盯著大門看，沒人進出就不會隨便拉警報。
body.en: Your menu bar will no longer inexplicably re-render its layout due to unrelated file changes. Previously, when the system listened in the background, it watched the entire data directory, meaning any agent writing to an unrelated status file would cause the menu bar to foolishly trigger a full visual refresh. Now, it strictly watches only the specific directories where Claude and Codex save their usage history, and if the status title hasn't actually changed, it won't waste effort re-rendering the layout. It's like a security guard who used to trigger a building-wide alarm every time they saw movement inside, but now strictly watches the front door and only sounds the alarm when someone actually enters or leaves.

items.original: **Idle menu-bar refreshes no longer react to unrelated agent state writes**: FSEvents now watches Claude and Codex usage-history directories instead of their entire data roots, and unchanged status titles no longer trigger redundant AppKit layout work.

entries: **Year in review in the HTML report**: two new sections that turn a year of local usage into one glance. A GitHub-style 52-week contribution heatmap shades each day by how many tokens you burned, with your current and longest active streaks and your busiest day called out beside it. A "Wrapped" card sums up the year — total tokens, cost, active days, longest streak, and your most-used model and project — and crowns you with the spirit you leaned on most: a phoenix if you ran more Claude, a dragon if you ran more Codex. All computed from local files, no network.

**Reports stay fast on huge histories**: the year of data behind those sections is cached to disk and served instantly on repeat opens, only recomputed once it goes stale — so the report opens quickly even when your logs are enormous.

title.zh-TW: 年度回顧把一整年的 AI 用量做成榜單，還送你一隻代表神獸
title.en: A year-in-review turns your year of AI usage into a recap, and crowns you a spirit beast

body.zh-TW: 想回味過去這一年你到底多用力在用 AI，現在報表會幫你做成一份年度回顧。HTML 報表新增兩個段落，把你一整年的本地用量濃縮成一眼看完的摘要。第一個是仿 GitHub 風格的 52 週貢獻熱度圖（contribution heatmap，那種一格一格、顏色越深代表那天越活躍的年度方格圖），每天依你燒掉多少 token（AI 計量的單位，回答越長花越多）來著色，旁邊還標出你目前跟歷來最長的連續活躍紀錄（streak，連續好幾天沒中斷使用），以及你最忙的那一天。第二個是一張「Wrapped」總結卡，把這一年算總帳：總共燒了多少 token、花了多少錢、活躍了幾天、最長連續紀錄，外加你最常用的模型跟最常跑的專案；最後還會依你這一年到底比較常用哪個 AI，封你一個守護精靈——跑 Claude 多的是鳳凰（phoenix），跑 Codex 多的是龍（dragon）。全部只用你電腦裡的本地檔案算出來，不碰網路。就像 Spotify 年度回顧那樣，把你一整年的習慣做成一張精彩榜單，只不過這回統計的是你跟 AI 一起熬夜幹活的足跡，最後還會依你偏愛哪個 AI 給你一隻代表神獸。
body.en: Want to look back on how hard you leaned on AI over the past year? The report now turns it into a year-in-review. The HTML report gains two new sections that distill a full year of local usage into a single glance. The first is a GitHub-style 52-week contribution heatmap (that yearly grid of squares where darker means a busier day), shading each day by how many tokens (the unit AI usage is metered in; longer answers cost more) you burned, with your current and all-time longest active streaks (streak — consecutive days of unbroken usage) and your single busiest day called out beside it. The second is a "Wrapped" summary card that tallies up the year: total tokens burned, total cost, active days, longest streak, plus your most-used model and most-run project; finally it crowns you a guardian spirit based on which AI you actually ran more this year — a phoenix if you leaned on Claude, a dragon if you leaned on Codex. Everything is computed purely from local files on your machine, with no network. It's like a Spotify year-end recap turning a year of listening habits into a vivid rundown — except this time what's tallied is your trail of late nights grinding with AI, capped with a spirit beast chosen by which AI you favored.

items.original: **Year in review in the HTML report**: two new sections that turn a year of local usage into one glance. A GitHub-style 52-week contribution heatmap shades each day by how many tokens you burned, with your current and longest active streaks and your busiest day called out beside it. A "Wrapped" card sums up the year — total tokens, cost, active days, longest streak, and your most-used model and project — and crowns you with the spirit you leaned on most: a phoenix if you ran more Claude, a dragon if you ran more Codex. All computed from local files, no network.

title.zh-TW: 紀錄檔再巨大，報表開啟依然飛快
title.en: Even with enormous logs, the report still opens instantly

body.zh-TW: 就算你的紀錄檔已經累積得超巨大，報表開起來還是飛快。上述年度回顧背後那一整年的資料，現在會快取（cache，先把算好的結果暫存在磁碟裡、下次要用直接拿、不必重算）到磁碟上，你重複打開報表時幾乎是即時呈現，只有當資料過期了才會重新計算一次。所以即使你本地的 log 檔案龐大無比，報表依然能快速打開。就像一家餐廳把常客每天點的菜先整理成一本速查表，熟客一進門照表上菜立刻端出來，只有當你今天新點了別的菜，才需要重新謄寫一次。
body.en: Even if your logs have grown enormous, the report still opens in a flash. The full year of data behind the year-in-review above is now cached (cache — stashing the already-computed result on disk so it can be grabbed directly next time without re-computing) to disk, so when you reopen the report it appears almost instantly, recomputing only once the data has gone stale. So even with an enormous local log file, the report still opens fast. It's like a restaurant that pre-compiles its regulars' daily orders into a quick-reference sheet, so the moment a familiar face walks in the usual dishes come straight out — and only when you order something new today does it have to rewrite the page.

items.original: **Reports stay fast on huge histories**: the year of data behind those sections is cached to disk and served instantly on repeat opens, only recomputed once it goes stale — so the report opens quickly even when your logs are enormous.
